this is a KRA, that's right, KRA, race comp. the point is to make a KRA race, if executed properly. the longer, the better. try to make it around the size, maybe a bit bigger, of n_c_s's race comp: Small Race Comp

edit: make it whatever size you want. size won't make your score increase, but length might.

example: Keep the Rocket Alive

the more close calls* the better

*close calls include:
1. the rocket should get pretty close to tiles
2. the rocket should get pretty close to the ninja.

Judges:
me
mc_george
DemonzLunchBreak

Back-up judge:
TBA*

*back-up judge will be used if any judges enter

deadline: probably in 2 or so weeks depending on how many people enter.

judging criteria:
?/25 for good flow (edit: flow demo must be provided)
?/25 for close calls (how many and how close they were)
?/25 length
?/25 for overall level

awards:
1st place: ded and sig tag* saying you won this comp
2nd place: ded or sig tag saying you got 2nd place
3rd place: same as 2nd place

*i don't know how to make sigs or sig tags, so i need a judge who knows how
**okay. i desperately need a back-up judge who knows how to make sig tags

did i forget to mention anything? if not... Start mapmaking!!!
